full_name: Geraldine Brooks | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 Fiction & Poetry Vera M. Schuyler Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Geraldine Brooks is the author of two novels: March (Viking, 2005), which imagines a year at war for the absent father in Louisa May Alcott’s Little Women, and Year of Wonders: A Novel of the Plague (Viking, 2001). In addition, she has published two works of nonfiction: Nine Parts of Desire: The Hidden World of Islamic Women (Knopf, 1995) and Foreign Correspondence: A Pen Pal’s Journey from Down Under to All Over (Doubleday, 1998).
